descriptions.text: Potion of Dinosaur Repellent. Drink this if your party is attacked by a pack of dinosaurs, and they’ll eat you last. Effect lasts a full 30 hours.

recap.text: Carl sorts through his loot and finds mostly the usual: junk clothing and weapons, healing and mana restoration potions, a single invisibility potion, hobgoblin dynamite, and his first Good Healing Potions, which Mordecai calls a sign he is progressing nicely. Then he reaches a Potion of Dinosaur Repellent, and Mordecai's uh-oh does not help. Drunk when a pack of dinosaurs attacks, it makes them eat the drinker last.

Mongo rushes out of the gate into the jungle with Donut on his back, and forty velociraptors in the clearing all watch him. Carl took one of his ten dinosaur repellent potions, but Donut refused hers, and he regrets not making her. After the boss fight, Donut says Eva stole all the repellent potions and did not take one, and Katia says a dinosaur bit Eva and she lies buried, not yet dead.

beats.headline: Mordecai says uh-oh
beats.text: Carl works through his loot. It is mostly the regular stuff: junk clothing and weapons, healing potions and mana restorations, a single invisibility potion, hobgoblin dynamite, and the first Good Healing Potions, which Mordecai calls a sign he is progressing nicely. Then comes something a little concerning, and Mordecai's uh-oh when it appears does not help. A Potion of Dinosaur Repellent: drink it if your party is attacked by a pack of dinosaurs, and they'll eat you last.
beats.gist: Carl's loot holds a Potion of Dinosaur Repellent, which makes dinosaurs eat the drinker last.

beats.headline: Forty pairs of eyes
beats.text: Mongo rushes out of the gate into the jungle with Donut on his back, and the shrieks that follow are not his. Carl has received ten dinosaur repellent potions since the end of the previous floor, and the description is vague about what the potion actually does. He took one earlier. Donut refused, afraid it would make her pet shy away from her, and he regrets not making her take it. In the clearing ahead, forty velociraptors surround Donut and Mongo, every one of them watching Mongo.
beats.gist: Donut and Mongo rush into the jungle, where forty velociraptors surround them, all watching Mongo.

beats.headline: On the bathroom counter
beats.text: Past the security checks, the crawlers are ushered into the boudoir, a glorified locker room with cubicles and bathrooms on the way into the ballroom. Carl covers a bathroom counter with dinosaur repellent potions and half-splat potions, with a note: store the half-splat ready in your inventory and, if you have not already, drink the dinosaur one now. They may have to flee quickly, he warns, with loose, prey-driven dinosaurs everywhere. They want those attacking the hunters, not them.
beats.gist: Carl leaves dinosaur repellent and half-splat potions on a bathroom counter for the crawlers.

beats.headline: Stolen and not taken
beats.text: After the boss fight, Carl lies hurt and asks after Lucia and Eva. Lucia teleported away before it started, Donut tells him. Katia says Eva was bitten by a dinosaur and is buried over there, not dead yet, and Katia is looking for her. Eva stole all those dinosaur repellent potions, Donut adds, and she did not even take one.
beats.gist: Eva stole the dinosaur repellent potions, Donut says, but she took none herself and lies bitten and buried.
